question: Which film won the most awards at the 97th Academy Awards?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Anora**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Anora** won the **most awards** with a total of **five**.
 
• This included the prestigious **Best Picture** award.
 
• The film **Anora** also had multiple wins in categories including **Best Director**.
 
• The **telecast** of the ceremony drew **19.7 million viewers**.
 
• **Sean Baker** directed **Anora** and matched the record for **most wins in a single year** (four Oscars).
